title: Add Poll/Vote Widget
content: Create poll component. Container: bg-white rounded-xl p-6 shadow. Question: text-lg font-bold mb-4. Options: space-y-3. Option button: w-full text-left p-3 border rounded-lg hover:border-blue-500, radio indicator and text. After vote: show results with progress bars and percentages. Total votes: text-sm text-gray-500 mt-4. Expires: countdown or expiry date.

variants.simple: Create voting poll with options and results display.
variants.detailed: Create poll component. Container: bg-white rounded-xl p-6 shadow. Question: text-lg font-bold mb-4. Options: space-y-3. Option button: w-full text-left p-3 border rounded-lg hover:border-blue-500, radio indicator and text. After vote: show results with progress bars and percentages. Total votes: text-sm text-gray-500 mt-4. Expires: countdown or expiry date.
variants.advanced: Create full polling component. Poll types: single choice, multiple choice, ranked choice, rating scale, open-ended text. Before voting: option buttons/checkboxes, vote button, option to see results without voting. After voting: transition to results view, highlight user choice. Results display: horizontal progress bars with percentages, vote counts, winner highlighted. Animations: bars animate to width on reveal, count up numbers. Live results: real-time updates via WebSocket, pulse animation on vote count change. User vote: indicator on which option user chose, change vote option if allowed. Expiration: countdown timer, "Poll closed" state after expiry, voting disabled. Scheduling: future start date, "Poll opens in X". Permissions: require login, one vote per user (or per IP for anonymous), require email verification. Creator options: end poll early, delete options, reset votes. Share: share buttons, embed code for external sites. Poll series: multiple questions in sequence. Analysis: breakdown by demographic if available. Comments: discussion section below poll. Report: flag inappropriate options. Accessibility: fieldset/legend for question, proper radio/checkbox semantics, results table alternative. Moderation: approve options before showing, hide inappropriate content.
